title: Kickoff notes
caption: Seven pages from one meeting: the project, two people, an API, a policy and an overview.
verdict: The first source creates the wiki: a page for the source, pages for the project, two people and the Billing API, a page for the retention policy, and an overview. Nothing existed before, so every line is new.
lesson: One source fans out into several pages. Each fact is filed where someone will look for it later, not left inside the meeting notes.
